name: Cavaliere
description: The standard knightly armatura of the Order, balanced in armour and mobility. Its sturdy plates give a small boost to defence.

name: Bastiun
description: A massive armatura built to hold the bastions, slow but hard to break. Its heavy plates add defence at the cost of agility.

name: Lanza
description: A knight's armatura built around the weapon, its arms reinforced for heavy strikes. Adds weapon skill.

name: Kaptan
description: A commander's armatura with refined mechanisms that improve power, dexterity and agility in equal measure.

name: Ħaddiem
description: A light militia armatura made in Maltese workshops, quick on its feet and resistant to strain.

name: Moschetta
description: A light armatura for militia arquebusiers, built to steady the aim and move fast between positions.

name: Artiġjan
description: A light militia harness reinforced by Maltese craftsmen, sturdy and nimble for its class.

name: Yeniçeri
description: The janissary armatura, disciplined and versatile, improving aim, weapon skill and agility.

name: Sipahi
description: A swift cavalry armatura of the Ottoman provinces, the fastest on the field.

name: Humbaracı
description: A heavy-set armatura for the bombardiers, slow but strong enough to hurl bombs far.

name: Levend
description: The light armatura of the Barbary corsairs, extremely agile and suited to boarding fights.

name: Reis
description: A corsair captain's armatura, strong and quick, built for leading boarding parties.

name: Prototipo
description: Scala's experimental armatura, a steam-driven machine of unusual power.

name: Supply Barge
description: A supply barge armoured for the siege, barely mobile and vulnerable.

name: Siege Tower
description: Scala's armoured siege tower, slow and immensely tough, bristling with guns.

name: Colossus
description: Scala's masterpiece, a towering steam giant of immense power and armour.
